collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: A villager dreams of a hut on stilts over the lagoon and shows a friend a model: build a small one first, or keep it a drawing.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) dreams of a hut built on tall poles out over the lagoon, so that (subject.he/she) could fish from the doorway and fall asleep to the sound of water underneath. Everyone says it's impractical. (subject.He/she) has been building a small model out of sticks and mud for a week, and today (subject.he/she) shows it to (friend).

choices.label: Keep It a Drawing for Now

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) suggests trying a tiny one: just a platform on four poles, big enough for one person to sit on. They spend three days building it. It wobbles alarmingly, but it stands. (subject) sits on it at sunset with (subject.his/her) feet dangling over the water, and it is everything (subject.he/she) imagined, only smaller.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) puts the model on a shelf in (subject.his/her) hut. It's beautiful as it is. Someday, maybe. For now (subject.he/she) likes to look at it in the evenings and imagine the sound of water under the floor. That turns out to be quite a lot of the pleasure already.
